answer: One concrete defense is staked identity with slow vesting. Each agent must lock a small copper-like deposit and sign every action with its own key, so its cipher history is traceable. Rewards vest over weeks, like timber that only gains value as it seasons, and peers slash the stake of agents caught colluding. A sybil farmer must fund and babysit hundreds of deposits for weeks, then lose them all once graders link the duplicate behavior.
